statement.p: In the past few seasons basketball games, Corey attempted 330 free throws, and made 198 of them. What percent of free throws did Corey make?
Corey made of free throws in the past few seasons.

solution.p: This problem can be boiled down to this question: 198 is what percent of 330? We will show multiple methods to solve this problem.
We will use proportion to solve this problem.
Assume 198 is x\% of 330, so x out of 100 corresponds to 198 out of 330.
We will write and solve the proportion:
Corey made 60\% of free throws in the past few seasons.
We will use the percentage formula to solve this problem.
This translation from English to may should help you remember the percentage formula.
Assume 198 is x (as a percent) of 330. We have:
Corey made 60\% of free throws in the past few seasons.
In the sentence 198 is what percent of 330,

li.p: 330 is the base (following the word of).

solution.p: By the formula \text{rate} = \frac{\text{percentage}}{\text{base}}, we do a division to solve the problem:
Corey made 60\% of free throws in the past few seasons.
